parent_weights: the pinned v0.1 final adapter; identical warm start for every arm
choice_loss: cross entropy over log likelihoods of ADMIT and DEFER label tokens only, excluding EOS
ce_loss: original v0.1 answer-token plus EOS causal LM loss
balanced_batch: two examples from each class, cycling deterministic shuffled pools; no new labels
shuffled_control: fixed seed permutation of training targets; validated native labels retained separately
fresh_labels: generated from native receipts only AFTER all arm weights and fresh predictions are durably saved
evaluation: same two label-token likelihoods without EOS for every arm; fixed 0.5 cutoff
calibration_comparator: parent threshold selected only on old training rows, then frozen before fresh labels
holdout_policy: old held-out cases are now development evidence; fresh labels cannot select arms, steps or hyperparameters; retain all results without retries

live_advisory.authority: read-only walk estimate; existing core, metacognitive gate and native guards retain all authority

scope: one deterministic software fixture family, not free generation, other bodies or consciousness
